fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) carry headline/articleBody-style fields extracted from the page's NewsArticle ld+json block. Latest-mode records (S2-rss) carry title/link-style fields from the RSS feed. Upstream JSON-LD/RSS is passed through close to verbatim, so field shapes (e.g. author as a string vs a joined list) can vary between articles.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value that produced this record: the article URL in article mode, or the literal string 'latest' in latest mode.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record: S1-jsonld (article NewsArticle ld+json), S2-rss (RSS feed item), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_paywalled.title: Paywalled
_paywalled.description: Article mode only. True when the NewsArticle ld+json's isAccessibleForFree field was explicitly False; derived defensively, not hardcoded.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article mode only. Article headline, raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle.headline.

description.title: Description
description.description: Article-mode: JSON-LD NewsArticle.description (dek/summary). Latest-mode: RSS <description> teaser text (not full article body).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Article mode only. Full article text, raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle.articleBody.

author.title: Author
author.description: Article mode only. Author name(s) flattened from JSON-LD NewsArticle.author, which upstream may be a bare string, a single {name} object, or a list of {name} objects (joined with ', ' when a list).

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Article mode only. Publisher name flattened from JSON-LD NewsArticle.publisher (string, object, or list of objects, same flattening as author).

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: Article mode only. Raw passthrough of JSON-LD NewsArticle.datePublished.

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: Article mode only. Raw passthrough of JSON-LD NewsArticle.dateModified.

articleSection.title: Article section
articleSection.description: Article mode only. Raw passthrough of JSON-LD NewsArticle.articleSection (e.g. usa, international, technology, society, opinion, climate, economy-and-business).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Article mode only. Raw passthrough of JSON-LD NewsArticle.keywords.

image.title: Image
image.description: Article mode: raw passthrough of JSON-LD NewsArticle.image. Latest mode: the media:content url attribute from the RSS item, or null when absent.

isAccessibleForFree.title: Is accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Article mode only. Raw passthrough of JSON-LD NewsArticle.isAccessibleForFree (the source field _paywalled is derived from).

title.title: Title
title.description: Latest mode only. RSS <title> of the headline item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Latest mode only. RSS <link> -- the article URL for this headline.

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: Latest mode only. RSS <guid> for the item.

pubDate.title: Publication date
pubDate.description: Latest mode only. Raw RSS <pubDate> string for the item.

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: Latest mode only. RSS dc:creator (author) of the item.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Latest mode only. List of RSS <category> values for the item, or null when none present.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
